The organization-scoped Access Analyzer is configured with type ORGANIZATION, but it can be created before the AWS Organization and its Access Analyzer service access are established. The provider documentation's organization analyzer example explicitly orders it after the organization.
This data source reads the organization in the master-account configuration while the example also creates that organization. Without ordering, the data lookup can run before creation and fail.
An organization-based Config aggregator can be created before AWS Organizations service integration is enabled by the organization resource; it should be ordered after the organization setup.

The aggregator uses the organization role ARN, but that reference only orders it after the role itself. The organization aggregator requires the role's AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations managed policy attachment to be in place first; the provider documentation's example explicitly depends on that attachment.
